name: Seasons
description: One dial turns the year: a bright quick spring, a warm wide summer, a dark crumbling autumn and a thin frozen winter, with every blend between, and the year can turn by itself.

params.name: Year
params.description: Where in the year the sound is: spring, summer, autumn, winter, a quarter of the dial each, blending between. Both ends meet. A turning year goes on from here.

params.name: Turning
params.description: How long one year takes when it turns by itself. Short is a restless cycle of colours, long is a change nobody notices happening.

params.name: Depth
params.description: How far into the season the sound goes. All the way down is the sound as it came in, with only Width still at work, and all the way up is the season at its strongest.

params.name: Space
params.description: How much of the season's room is heard: quick bright reflections in spring, a long soft haze in summer, a short dull room in autumn, a long thin tail in winter.

params.name: Motion
params.description: How much the season moves: a fast shimmer and a rising tail in spring, a slow sway from side to side in summer, a tumbling and sinking in autumn. Winter barely stirs.

params.name: Grit
params.description: How much of the season's texture is heard: glassy sparks above the sound in winter and spring, a warm pressing in summer, the top end breaking up in autumn.

params.name: Tails
params.description: Stretches or shortens every season's room. The middle is each season's own length. At the top a winter tail rings on long after the note.

params.name: Width
params.description: Stereo width of the seasoned sound, on top of what the season does itself: summer is wide and winter narrow. All the way down is mono.

params.name: Turn
params.description: Whether the year turns by itself. Still holds it where it has got to, Forward runs on from spring towards summer, Backward from spring towards winter.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the sound as it came in and the seasoned sound.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. One year dial blends four characters, each made of a tone pair, a small room, a movement and a texture, and a clock turns the dial.
